channel.title: The Grant Desk - Curatorial, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Curatorial, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: VisArts: Emerging Curator Program 2027 (Rockville, Maryland)
item.description: VisArts · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · USD 10,000 budget covering exhibition costs and curatorial fees, plus a year of mentorship and staff support for printing, promotion and programming. No application fee.

item.title: Tate x Delfina Foundation: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (London)
item.description: Tate and Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Non-salaried but fully supported: return economy-class flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement and visa support via Delfina Foundation, a living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, a London Underground and bus travel pass, a single bedroom at Delfina Foundation with shared facilities, and travel to other Tate galleries and UK/European cultural institutions. The Leonora Carrington fellowship adds a research resource allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Alkazi Foundation: Curatorial Research Fellowship 2027 (with CWIT and the V&A)
item.description: Alkazi Foundation for the Arts, with the Charles Wallace India Trust and the Victoria and Albert Museum · deadline 07 Nov 2026 · GBP 1,600 monthly stipend for 3 to 6 months, plus a GBP 800 contribution from CWIT towards international return airfare; visa expenses covered by the Alkazi Foundation. No application fee.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Curatorial Fellowship at HBK Braunschweig
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months (EUR 19,200 total), plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (the fellow pays EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs), a subsidy of up to EUR 4,000 for exhibition activities and a EUR 2,000 travel budget. No application fee.

item.title: 2027 LOOP Open Call for Exhibition Proposals (Seoul)
item.description: Alternative Space LOOP · deadline 05 Oct 2026 · Project grant of KRW 1,000,000, plus exhibition space at Alternative Space LOOP, curatorial and operational support, exhibition graphic design and promotion, and use of LOOP's available equipment. 1-2 individuals or teams are selected. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Pedantic Arts Residency and Research Grant 2027 (Pittsburgh)
item.description: Pedantic Arts Residency · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Residency: free furnished housing in a shared apartment plus a USD 2,000 living stipend (half on arrival, half on completion). Research Grant: a free private bedroom at the Pedantic Apartment plus a USD 500 or USD 1,000 honorarium at the grantee's discretion. Application free until 28 September 2026, then USD 20.

item.title: World of Art / SCCA-Ljubljana: Award for Curatorial Practices 2026
item.description: World of Art School, SCCA-Ljubljana, with Moderna galerija (MG+MSUM), Cukrarna/MGML and Center for Contemporary Arts Celje · deadline 23 Oct 2026 · Two cash awards: a Large Award of EUR 5,000 gross (minimum 10 completed projects in the last 15 years) and a Small Award of EUR 2,500 gross (minimum 3 completed projects in the last 5 years). No application fee.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary
item.description: Asymmetry Art Foundation, with Nottingham Contemporary · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Annual salary of GBP 27,556 for two years, plus pension and National Insurance contributions, annual leave in line with organisational policy plus UK bank holidays, visa and legal fee assistance where required, and a travel and relocation allowance. No application fee.

item.title: A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Fellowship 2028 (Chengdu)
item.description: A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Fully funded fellowship: private studio and accommodation, round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget, and a production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for materials and production (excluding living expenses). No application fee.

item.title: SAM Residencies Open Call: Cycle 4 (2027/2028) at Singapore Art Museum
item.description: Singapore Art Museum · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of SGD 1,500 plus a shared studio or co-working space for all residents. International residents also receive a return economy flight, housing arrangement and visa assistance; Singapore-based residents receive an additional monthly local allowance of SGD 250. No application fee.

item.title: Ernest Albert Invitational 2027: Reflective Residency at Cas-co x Kunsthal Mechelen
item.description: Cas-co, Leuven and Kunsthal Mechelen · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,480 total including VAT: an artist fee of EUR 1,100 per month, a transportation allowance of EUR 120 per month, and a one-time production budget of EUR 600. No application fee.

item.title: Tilting Axis Fellowship 2027 for Caribbean-Based Practitioners (with Nieuwe Instituut)
item.description: Tilting Axis, with Nieuwe Instituut, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, Fresh Milk (Barbados), RAA! (Aruba) and Instituto Buena Bista (Curacao) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,500 stipend per fellow, plus up to EUR 1,000 travel budget for research-related movement and full coverage of airfare and Netherlands programming during the visit. No application fee.

item.title: NARS Foundation: Curatorial Fellowship 2027 (NYC)
item.description: NARS Foundation · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend for the six-month fellowship, plus sustained access to the NARS international and US artist residency community and staff support for the resulting exhibitions. No application fee listed for the curatorial track.

item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Art Program
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per application, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Requests above EUR 5,000 require at least 30 percent co-financing of the total budget from third parties. Compliance with the kunstenaarshonorarium.nl artist fee guideline is part of the assessment. No application fee.

item.title: The Photographers' Gallery: Future of Archives, Whose Archive is it Anyway? (Call for Speakers)
item.description: The Photographers' Gallery · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 200 speaker fee for each selected speaker. No application fee.

item.title: UCLA Modern Endangered Archives Program (MEAP): 2026-27 Call for Applications
item.description: UCLA Library, Modern Endangered Archives Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Planning Grants up to USD 20,000 (up to 1 year) for collection evaluation, survey and inventory work before digitization. Project Grants up to USD 70,000 (up to 2 years) for digitization and metadata creation on well-organized collections, or curation of existing digital assets. Regional Grants up to USD 100,000 (up to 2 years) for digital collections drawing on three or more institutions, families or repositories around one theme, hosted by an organization with prior MEAP experience. A separate AV Grants track (up to USD 100,000, for audio, video and film) opens in April 2027. No application fee.

item.title: transmediale 2028: Open Call for Festival Curation
item.description: transmediale e.V. · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 40,000 net for an individual or EUR 50,000 net for a group, as a freelance contract covering December 2026 to March 2028 (ca. 70% commitment overall, full-time from October 2027). Possible contract extension for the 2029 edition, decided by the Advisory and Executive Board in summer 2027. No application fee.

item.title: apexart Open Calls: Curatorial Proposals for NYC and International Exhibitions
item.description: apexart · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 10,000 per selected exhibition: USD 8,000 for expenses (curator travel, artwork shipping, artist and participant honorariums, equipment, installation) plus an honorarium of up to USD 2,000 for the curator/organizer. For exhibitions outside NYC, apexart matches up to USD 1,000 for venue rental if needed. apexart additionally covers insurance, advertising, publicity, brochure design/printing/mailing, the opening reception and (for NYC) documentation, and handles most logistics. No application fee.

item.title: UNIDEE Residency Programs: Visiting Research Curator 2027-28
item.description: Fondazione Pistoletto Cittadellarte and UNIDEE Residency Programs · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · Compensation and contractual terms commensurate with the candidate's level of professional experience, starting from a gross amount of EUR 22,000 for the appointment, excluding travel and hospitality, which are covered separately. No application fee.

item.title: MMCA International Researcher Residency Program 2027
item.description: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (MMCA) · deadline 18 Sep 2026 · Monthly grant of KRW 1,200,000 (approx. USD 850), total KRW 3,600,000 for the residency period, plus a private live-in studio provided free of charge

item.description:
• This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
  • 2027 d/p Curator Support Open Call (Seoul)
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1iSjEuCjay7DhL1AF1NCePu-5RV3t_10WT0CNcjNNJy8/preview
    d/p, sponsored by NakwonSangga · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Curatorial grant of KRW 4,000,000 (including tax) per selected curator or team, plus use of d/p's approximately 187 square metre exhibition space for a five-week exhibition and curatorial collaboration with the d/p team. item.title: 1 new Curatorial grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Delfina Foundation: Open Call for Curators Based in Central and West Africa (London residency)
    https://www.delfinafoundation.com/open-calls/current/open-call-for-curators-based-in-central-and-west-africa/
    Delfina Foundation · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Fully supported: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials and research allowance of GBP 70 per week, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. Supported by Delfina Foundation's Network of Patrons for Africa. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Curatorial grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Upe Foundation Curatorial Fellowship at Camden Art Centre 2026
    https://upefoundation.org/news/open-call-upe-foundation-curatorial-fellowship-at-camden-art-centre
    Upe Foundation (in partnership with Camden Art Centre) · deadline 13 Jul 2026 · Salary of GBP 30,960 per year. A full-time Assistant Curator role on a 12-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of a further 6-month extension (18 months total) subject to formal review and mutual agreement.

item.title: 1 new Curatorial grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Open Call 2027: Galerie mladych (Galerie TIC Brno)
    https://galerie-tic.cz/en/open-call-2027-2
    Galerie TIC Brno · deadline 20 Jul 2026 · The gallery covers the financial costs of exhibition installation, an artist/curator fee, collection and transport of the exhibition, and basic PR (photodocumentation included).
